adjudication.rationale: In `packages/trpc/server/routers/viewer/organizations/create.handler.ts`, the conditional spread was effectively inverted. Previously `slug` was written when `!IS_TEAM_BILLING_ENABLED` and `requestedSlug` metadata was written when `IS_TEAM_BILLING_ENABLED`. After the change, when team billing is disabled the create payload includes neither `slug` nor `requestedSlug` (`...(IS_TEAM_BILLING_ENABLED ? { slug } : {})` and `...(IS_TEAM_BILLING_ENABLED ? { requestedSlug: slug } : {})`), and when team billing is enabled it now writes `slug` directly at creation. This is a concrete behavioral change introduced by the diff and can break org slug persistence/routing for the disabled-billing path.
